title: Boundary factorization maps with integer indexing
statement: Let $B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex. The boundary factorization consists of the projection $K^p\to\operatorname{im}(d^{p})$ indexed as $B^{p+1}=\operatorname{im}(d^{(p+1)-1})$, and the inclusion $B^p\to Z^p(K)$. The first is the canonical image factor, with the equality $(p+1)-1=p$ transported on its source. The second is the lift of the image inclusion through the kernel of the next differential. Composing them with the respective inclusions gives $d^p$ and the image inclusion.

def cartanEilenbergBoundaryProjection
    {B : Type u} [Category.{v} B] [Abelian B] (K : CochainComplex B ℤ) (p : ℤ) :
    K.X p ⟶ image (K.d ((p + 1) - 1) (p + 1))
